verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can search and browse the web, including login-gated pages. They also describe running browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel with structured results, plus webpage screenshots. That covers the core of operating a browser on the user's behalf for research. Approval and clarification flows support delegated multi-step work, but the docs do not describe transactional interaction on sites. missing for 10: explicit documentation of interactive website actions (form filling, clicking through flows, submitting transactions), independent or hands-on corroboration of browser-agent behavior.
